mapper.select: SELECT i.id AS ingredientId, i.name AS ingredientName, MAX(c.name) AS categoryName, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(IFNULL(di.weight_g, 0) * IFNULL(wr.portions, 0)), 0) / 1000.0, 3) AS totalWeightKg, ROUND(i.price, 4) AS unitPrice, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(IFNULL(di.weight_g, 0) * IFNULL(wr.portions, 0)), 0) / 1000.0 * IFNULL(i.price, 0), 2) AS totalCost, CASE WHEN COUNT(wr.id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS used FROM ingredient i LEFT JOIN dish_ingredient di ON di.ingredient_id = i.id LEFT JOIN weekly_recipe wr ON wr.dish_id = di.dish_id AND DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(wr.week_key, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL wr.day_index DAY) BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') LEFT JOIN ingredient_category c ON i.category_id = c.id GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.price, c.name ORDER BY totalWeightKg DESC, i.name

SELECT d.id AS dishId, d.name AS dishName, d.category AS category, COUNT(wr.id) AS useCount, COALESCE(SUM(IFNULL(wr.portions, 0)), 0) AS totalPortions, CASE WHEN COUNT(wr.id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS used FROM dish d LEFT JOIN weekly_recipe wr ON wr.dish_id = d.id AND DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(wr.week_key, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL wr.day_index DAY) BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY d.id, d.name, d.category ORDER BY useCount DESC, d.name
